FLASHBACK TO 1934, shows Belgrave's cross-country runners and officials with their trophy collection which includes the London-Brighton (News of the World) Trophy, Southern and Surrey County cups. The team was also placed in the National and South of Thames Senior and Junior races.
BACK ROW (l.to r.):E.A.Duffett,R.Savage,A.T.Jordan,B.Lindsey,S.T.Ring,F.R.Webb,N.Dewberry, A. Robertshaw, W. Mitchell, A. Patience, L. Rollins.
CENTRE ROW (l. to r.):T.Eaton(masseur),D.Patience,R.Patience,J.Belchamber(Past President), W.H.Hare(Hon.Tresurer),J.R.McKay(President),W.Bayliss(General Hon.Secretary),E.Gordon(Past President),F.Walker,C.Penny,WG.Webb.
